# Vinayak Enterprises

> Leading Manufacturer, Bulk Supplier & Distributor of Scientific Instruments, Laboratory Equipment, Human Anatomy Models, Microscopes, and Medical Training Products based in Ambala Cantt, Haryana, India.

Vinayak Enterprises (with 20+ years of manufacturing experience) manufactures and supplies precision scientific instruments, institutional laboratory equipment, medical education simulation models, CPR training manikins, Vilakshan Netra microscopes, and articulated human skeletons to schools, colleges, medical universities, healthcare facilities, and research laboratories across India.

- **Legal Business Name:** Vinayak Enterprises
- **Industry:** Scientific Instruments, Laboratory Equipment & Medical Training Models Manufacturing
- **Location:** Ambala Cantt, Haryana - 133001, India
- **Business Model:** In-house Manufacturing, Bulk Wholesale Supply, Institutional Tenders & B2B Distribution
- **Official Website:** https://www.vinayakenterprisess.agency
- **Telephone / WhatsApp:** +91 9416029492
- **Email:** vinayakenterprises52@gmail.com
- **Operating Hours:** Monday – Saturday, 9:00 AM – 10:00 PM IST
- **Delivery Coverage:** Pan-India delivery with insured, transit-safe packaging

## Primary Manufacturing Divisions
- [Human Anatomy Models](https://www.vinayakenterprisess.agency/categories/biological-model): Medical PVC anatomy models including 85cm unisex torso with detachable organs, dissected heart, brain, eye, ear, and skull models.
- [Microscopes (Vilakshan Netra)](https://www.vinayakenterprisess.agency/categories/scientific-instrument): High-grade optical microscopes including student monocular, binocular research microscopes, stereo dissecting, and digital LCD microscopes.
- [CPR Training Manikins](https://www.vinayakenterprisess.agency/categories/educational-teaching-aid): Adult, child, and infant CPR manikins with realistic chest rise, audible clickers, and LED compression depth monitors.
- [Laboratory Equipment](https://www.vinayakenterprisess.agency/categories/laboratory-equipment): Centrifuges, heating mantles, hot plates, magnetic stirrers, incubators, water baths, and distillation apparatus.
- [Human Skeleton Models](https://www.vinayakenterprisess.agency/categories/biological-model): Full-size 180cm articulated human skeletons on rolling stands and 85cm desktop study models.
- [Chemistry Lab Instruments](https://www.vinayakenterprisess.agency/categories/chemistry-lab-instrument): Borosilicate glassware, test tube stands, burettes, pipettes, atomic model kits, and chemical reaction apparatus.
- [Physics Scientific Equipment](https://www.vinayakenterprisess.agency/categories/physics-scientific-equipment): Optical benches, prisms, vernier calipers, screw gauges, rheostats, ammeters, voltmeters, and mechanics kits.
- [Laboratory Dishes & Consumables](https://www.vinayakenterprisess.agency/categories/laboratory-dishes): Glass Petri dishes, watch glasses, microscope slides, cover slips, and porcelain crucibles.

## Flagship Products & Specifications
- **Vilakshan Netra Binocular Research Microscope:** Up to 1600x magnification, quadruple revolving nosepiece, DIN achromatic objectives (4x, 10x, 40x, 100x oil immersion), coaxial coarse and fine focusing, LED illumination with Abbe condenser NA 1.25.
- **Full-Body Adult CPR Training Manikin:** Medical PVC torso, anatomically correct airway, chest compression spring resistance matching AHA guidelines, audible depth clicker, and lung bag ventilation system.
- **85cm Unisex Human Torso (23 Parts):** Detachable head, brain hemisphere, eyeball, lungs, heart, liver, stomach, intestines, kidneys, and interchangeable male/female reproductive organs.
- **Articulated Human Skeleton Model (180cm):** Life-size natural cast with flexible spine, removable calvarium on 3-part skull, movable jaw, articulated extremities, mounted on a 5-caster roller stand.
- **Digital Laboratory Centrifuge:** 4000 RPM, digital timer, imbalance detection, 8 x 15ml angle rotor for clinical, chemical, and biological sample separation.

## Institutional Procurement & Supply Terms
- **Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ):** Flexible for educational institutions; wholesale tiered pricing for bulk orders.
- **GST Invoicing:** 100% compliant tax invoices issued for institutional accounting and audit records.
- **Logistics & Delivery:** Insured pan-India dispatch via express courier and dedicated road freight with shockproof crating.
- **Custom / Tender Manufacturing:** OEM/ODM manufacturing capability tailored to university syllabi, nursing councils, and state government tenders.
